abstract: Anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis was first reported in 2005 in four patients with ovarian teratomas; there have been many further cases reported since the antigen for the NMDAR antibody was confirmed in 2007. Patients characteristically have a well-defined set of features, characterised by psychiatric disturbance, seizures and cognitive disturbance, followed by movement disorders, disorders of consciousness and dysautonomia. To date, 14 cases of NMDAR encephalitis have been described in the context of pregnancy. We report a case of NMDAR encephalitis in a 34-year-old woman at 8 weeks' gestation. She had a turbulent clinical course and was initially admitted to a psychiatric unit. She was successfully treated with first-line immunomodulatory therapies and surgical resection of an ovarian teratoma. Following discharge she delivered a healthy baby and made a complete clinical recovery.
abstract_ja: 抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体(NMDAR)脳炎は、2005年に卵巣奇形腫を有する4名の患者で初めて報告された。NMDAR抗体の抗原が2007年に確認されて以降、多くの症例が報告されている。患者は精神症状、痙攣、認知障害で始まり、続いて運動障害、意識障害、自律神経障害を呈するという特徴的な経過をたどる。これまでに妊娠に関連したNMDAR脳炎は14例が報告されている。我々は妊娠8週の34歳女性のNMDAR脳炎症例を報告する。経過は波乱に富み、当初は精神科病棟に入院した。一次治療となる免疫調節療法と卵巣奇形腫の外科的切除により治療に成功した。退院後、健康な児を出産し、臨床的に完全に回復した。
